title: Observer reports
queueSub: Filed after each match by the appointed observer
noReport: No report filed for this match yet.
noReportHint: The observer has 48 hours after kick-off.
criterionAveragesSub: Every filed report in this scope
releaseBody: {name} will be able to read this report in their space and will be told. A released report stays released.

form.pickHint: Played matches in your scope with no filed report.
form.noMatch: Every played match has its report.
form.title: Observer report
form.markHint: Mark from 0 to 10, one decimal (7.5). The overall mark is weighted by the platform grid.
form.notesHint: Written in your own language; confidential until the report is released.
form.fileHint: Once filed, the report goes to the federation and counts in the referee's figures; only the federation can change it after that.

errors.mark: A mark from 0 to 10, one decimal at most.
errors.markRequired: Every criterion must be marked to file.
errors.clipText: Describe the incident (120 characters at most).
errors.duplicate: This observer already has a report on this match.
errors.self_assessment: An official cannot assess their own match.
errors.marks_incomplete: Every criterion must be marked to file.
errors.unknown_criterion: The grid has changed: reload the page.
errors.no_referee: This match has no referee on record to assess.
errors.not_filed: Only a filed report can be released.

mine.dutiesHint: Matches you are appointed to observe: report due within 48 hours.
mine.receivedHint: Reports on your matches, once the federation has released them.

grid.title: Evaluation grid
grid.subtitle: The criteria observers mark and their weight in the overall mark, for the whole platform.
grid.criteriaHint: 2 to 12 criteria; the weights, whole numbers, total 100.
grid.saved: Grid saved: the next reports will use it.
grid.confirmBody: The next reports will be marked on this grid. Reports already filed keep their marks and overall.
